reference: Required: the models on which the Stan NUTS reference (harbor/references/stan_core.py + lane_nuts.py) passed the 0.1-SD bench gate at the step 8 budget (3 reps, manifest budgets), measured 2026-11-28. Plain HMC (examples/samplers/hmc.py) passed the same four. Both missed eight_schools_centered, so it is run and reported, not required. To change the set, re-measure the reference on the candidate models (uv run apin autoresearch gate --submission harbor/tasks/a2-funnel-dynamics/tests/reference.py --lane A2 --models <list>, the generated copy of stan_core.py + lane_nuts.py), then bump id here, REAL_GATE_ID in flywheel/src/index.ts and the BACKFILL block in a new Flywheel migration together.
